plot: The day after the double splash, Pip and her grown-up helper Grumpy must make one film for the Wheelburg film contest by sunset with Hal's only camera, but Pip wants fast zooming cars and Grumpy films one slow leaf and a puddle; a camera tug of war ends in the grass, they split up and each film the same Main Street their own way (Turbo splashes Grumpy's puddle shot), and Hal joins the halves in a rush; the twist: he puts them side by side, so the screen shows Grumpy's 'two faces of one street', fast and slow at once, and they win the gold star; lesson: two different ideas can make one better idea; then Bertha sneezes and feels sick the night before the school farm trip.

script.title: 1 Camera, 2 Friends, 0 Agreement!

set.place: Wheelburg school yard, Main Street and the square, Monday afternoon until the film contest at sunset

script.description: Pip wants fast, Grumpy wants slow — and they have one camera. Inspector Bolt #22

beats.say: Action! Fast cars! Big jumps! Go, go, go!
Cut. Stop. Too fast. Nobody can see anything.
The film contest is at sunset! And we have nothing!
It was Monday afternoon, the day after the double splash.
Every Wheelburg kid was making a film with a grown-up helper.
The best film wins a gold star for my school door!
And I'll show the winner on the big screen tonight!
Hal lent them his old camera. Only one camera. For two.
My film is called Zoom! Racing! Jumping! Honking!
My film is called Leaf. One leaf. Falling. Slowly.
A leaf? For the whole film?!
Every street has two faces. A fast one and a slow one.
Everybody films the fast one. I like the slow one.
Slow is boring! Nobody watches boring!
Fast is blurry. Nobody watches blurry.
And that is how the whole afternoon went.
Pip filmed Turbo doing jumps. Very fast. Very wobbly.
Am I a movie star? Film my good side! Both sides!
Then Grumpy filmed a puddle. For five whole minutes.
Is the puddle going to do something? Ever?
Shh. It is reflecting the sky. That is the something.
Grumpy, give me the camera! It's my turn!
You had nine turns. I had one puddle.
Pip pulled one way. Grumpy pulled the other way.
The camera flew up high... and landed in the soft grass.
Goodness! Is everyone all right? Is the camera all right?
It's fine. Old cameras are tough. Like old trucks.
Pip, Grumpy. Tell me. What is your film about?
Fast!
Slow.
Ah. I see. A film about arguing. Very modern.
The sun is going down, my darlings! One hour left!
One hour? I can zoom around town twelve times in one hour!
Thank you, Turbo. Not helping.
We will lose. Our film is half fast and half slow.
Half a film is no film. Hmph.
Fine! I film my half. You film your half. Separately!
Fine. Separately. My favourite word.
Pip raced down Main Street, filming everything that moved.
Bakery! Zoom! Ducks! Zoom! Turbo's crossing! Zoom, zoom!
She zoomed so fast that she only filmed crumbs and feathers.
Crumbs? Where is the bakery? Where did the ducks go?
Stop, cars! Kids cross now! Hi, Pip! Am I in it?
Then Grumpy drove down the very same street. Very, very slowly.
Bakery. Warm bread. Ducks. Sleepy. Crossing. Quiet.
A leaf fell. Grumpy filmed it all the way down.
Got it. The leaf. The best moment of my day.
Same places. Same street. But they looked so different.
And then, right in Grumpy's quiet puddle shot...
Crossing guard coming through! Splash! Oops. Sorry!
Turbo. That was my best puddle.
Contest time! Everybody to the big screen! Hurry, hurry!
Quick! Give me both halves. I'll stick them together!
Hal hurried. He joined the two films in a very big rush.
Our film will be a mess. Fast, slow, fast, slow...
We will be last. Like a leaf. Falling.
The sun touched the hill. Every car in Wheelburg came to watch.
Film after film played. Everybody clapped for every single kid.
And the last film! By Pip and Grumpy!
I can't look. Tell me when it's over.
But in his big rush, Hal had made a mistake.
He didn't put the halves one after the other.
Oh no. I put them side by side! On one screen!
Left side, the bakery went zoom! Right side, warm and still.
Left, ducks racing. Right, ducks sleeping. One street, two faces.
Look! There's me! Fast me AND splashy me!
It's like the street is breathing! Fast, slow, fast, slow!
Remarkable. One street, two faces. Grumpy, you said that today!
I did. But I only made the slow face.
And I made the fast face! Together, it's the whole street!
Then everybody honked. The whole square honked.
The gold star goes to... Pip and Grumpy!
Pip got the gold star. And Grumpy got a big hug.
Hmph. Hugs are fast. ...I liked it anyway.
Two different ideas can make one better idea!
Well said, Pip. Different doesn't mean wrong.
And my big mistake made the best film. Ha!
Ah... ah... ACHOO!
Oh dear. My engine feels all fuzzy and sniffly.
But Bertha! Tomorrow is the school trip to the farm!
What do you think Bolt will find next time? We'll find out in the next episode!
